items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Tricky Turkey Sam in the context of a 1929 recording, but the interviewee (Juan Tizol) does not respond with any personal knowledge or relationship to this individual.

ctx.x: The question I wanted to ask you from the book by Gunther Schuler called Early Jazz -- Its Foots and Musical Development, he discusses the recording of "Tiger Rag" by Duke, which was in January of 1929 -- it was January 8, 1929, which was about 8 or 9 months before you joined Duke's band.

So he says here that Ellington's band presented a staggering array of nongimmicky, highly individual solos. Even Bigard's chromatic run, under other circumstances of a fairly tawdry ideas, had in this context a drive that turns it into the high point of the record. ""
